g.title: vhtScheduler
g.text: require same TID and valid identities

g.title: vhtRules
g.text: fresh CSI / active group / Block Ack

g.title: note
g.text: The scheduler selects users, RUs, and policy outcomes.
EDCA still owns contention and TXOP state; PHY mode objects
remain authoritative for legal modes and PPDU timing.
Scheduler observations are committed only after exchange validation.
